name: Agent Tool Security Governance
description: Workflow for prompt-injection defense, tool permission review, secret handling, exfiltration checks, approval gates, and safe agent tool rollout.

chain.step: Inventory tools, credentials, data classes, side effects, and trust boundaries.
Scan relevant code, prompts, docs, or manifests for secrets and unsafe tool patterns.
Classify prompt-injection, exfiltration, confused-deputy, lookalike-tool, overbroad-scope, and missing-approval risks.
Patch docs, prompts, skills, validators, or tool policies when concrete issues are found.
Use user-checkpoint for high-impact permission or destructive-operation decisions.
